text:
Type: TV bench with glass-front drawers
Use: holding a TV and media devices, storing games and cables; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, minimalist, modern
Materials: black laminated board, frosted glass drawer fronts, black bar handles
Colors: black, smoky frosted glass
Shape: low rectangular cabinet with two open shelves above two wide drawers with framed frosted glass panes, slim bar handles, cable hole, recessed plinth, solid and boxy, medium visual weight
Feel: sleek, dark, practical, understated
Goes with: grey or white walls, light or dark wood floors, chrome accents; modern living rooms and compact apartments

product.name: BRIMNES
product.description: This TV-bench has large drawers that make it easy to keep remote controls, game controllers and other TV accessories organised.
